picks.title: Strategy's STRC buybacks as a share of weekly STRC volume
picks.description: Strategy's buybacks of its STRC preferred as a share of weekly STRC trading volume, mostly 20-30% of volume since August.
picks.reason: Strategy disclosed a $228M STRC buyback this week, about seven times its 485 BTC purchase.

picks.title: 10-Year Government Bond Yields
picks.description: 10-year government bond yields for the US, UK, France, Germany and Japan since 2007, with US and UK yields near 5%.
picks.reason: The US 10-year is above 5% and global yields are in focus as markets wobble ahead of Nvidia.

picks.title: Bitcoin MVRV: market value ÷ realized value (on-chain cost basis)
picks.description: Bitcoin's MVRV (market value divided by on-chain realized value) alongside the BTC price since 2019.
picks.reason: Bitcoin slid to about $65K, down roughly 13% in a week, putting the on-chain cost basis back in view.

picks.title: SpaceX vs the rest of the world: orbital launch attempts per year
picks.description: Orbital launch attempts per year, SpaceX vs the rest of the world, with SpaceX's share of all launches.
picks.reason: After the Starship Flight 15 ship catch and a ULA launch failure, SpaceX's lead in the launch race is in the news.
